title: Pure Deep Sea
summary: Deep Sea is a WATER Sea Serpent Synchro archetype led by Deep Sea Diva and Deep Sea Aria that manipulates the top of the Deck and temporarily banishes cards from the opponent's hand. When Deep Sea Artisan or Sentry are sent to the GY to activate a WATER monster's effect, they trigger bonus revivals while Deep Sea Prima Donna converts banished opposing cards into Synchro climbs.

allow.Neptabyss, the Atlantean Prince: Level 1 Sea Serpent summoned from the Deck by Deep Sea Diva that sends Atlantean Dragoons for cost to search another Sea Serpent.
allow.Atlantean Dragoons: Sea Serpent that searches any Sea Serpent from the Deck when sent to the GY to activate a WATER monster's effect (like Deep Sea Minstrel).
allow.Moulinglacia the Elemental Lord: Searchable via Dragoons; Special Summons itself with 5 WATER monsters in the GY to discard 2 cards from the opponent's hand.
allow.Moray of Greed: Shuffles 2 WATER monsters from hand into the Deck to draw 3 cards.
allow.Coral Dragon: Level 6 WATER Synchro Tuner that discards Dragoons to pop a card and draws 1 when climbing into Chengying.
allow.Trishula, Dragon of the Ice Barrier: Level 9 WATER Synchro that banishes 3 opposing cards.
allow.Swordsoul Supreme Sovereign - Chengying: Level 10 WATER Synchro boss summoned via Deep Sea Prima Donna + Level 3 that banishes cards from field and GY whenever a card is banished.
allow.Toadally Awesome: Key WATER endboard omni-negate accessible via the deck's Level 2 or Rank 4 WATER monsters.

main: Deep Sea Diva
Iconic Level 2 Sea Serpent Tuner that Special Summons any Level 3 or lower Sea Serpent directly from the Deck upon Normal Summon.
Deep Sea Minstrel
Level 3 Sea Serpent Tuner that discards itself and 1 WATER monster (triggering Dragoons/Artisan) to look at the opponent's hand and banish 1 card until the End Phase.
Deep Sea Artisan
Adds the top card of your Deck to your hand when added from Deck/GY to hand, and revives a Level 4 or lower WATER monster when sent from the Deck to the GY by a WATER effect.
Deep Sea Sentry
Banishes 1 card from the opponent's hand until the End Phase when sent to the GY for a WATER effect, and stacks a Level 4 or lower WATER monster on Summon.
Deep Sea Aria
Banishes 1 WATER monster from your GY to add any Level 4 or lower Sea Serpent monster from your Deck to your hand.
Neptabyss, the Atlantean Prince
Summoned by Deep Sea Diva; sends Atlantean Dragoons from Deck to GY to search another Sea Serpent.
Atlantean Dragoons
Searches any Sea Serpent (including Diva, Minstrel, or Moulinglacia) whenever sent to the GY to activate a WATER monster's effect.
Moulinglacia the Elemental Lord
Discards 2 random cards from the opponent's hand when Special Summoned with 5 WATER monsters in the GY.
Magellanica, the Deep Sea City
Archetypal Field Spell that stacks a WATER monster on activation, modulates a WATER monster's Level by 1 or 2, and banishes 1 card from the opponent's hand when a WATER Synchro is summoned.
Moray of Greed
Shuffles 2 WATER monsters into the Deck to draw 3 cards.
extra: Signature Level 7 Synchro Tuner that returns a banished opponent's card to their hand to search or Special Summon a Level 4 or lower WATER monster from the Deck, and grants targeting immunity to Synchros made with it.
Signature Level 5 Synchro that discards a WATER monster to gain 800 ATK as a Quick Effect and revives a Level 5+ Sea Serpent when sent to the GY.
Level 6 WATER Synchro Tuner that discards Dragoons to pop a card and draws 1 when climbing into Chengying.
Trishula, Dragon of the Ice Barrier
Level 9 WATER Synchro that banishes 3 opposing cards.
Level 10 WATER Synchro boss made with Prima Donna that triggers whenever Deep Sea Minstrel or Aria banishes a card.
Rank 2: Quick Effect detaches an Aqua monster to negate and destroy an opponent's card or effect, and recycles WATER monsters.
